clean_repro.evidence_cmd: curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/insert -d '{"collectionName": "devreview_test", "data": [{"id": 0, "value": 0, "vector": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}, ...]}' && curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/load -d '{"collectionName": "devreview_test"}' && curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/collections/get_stats -d '{"collectionName": "devreview_test"}' && curl -X POST http://localhost:19530/v2/vectordb/entities/query -d '{"collectionName": "devreview_test", "filter": "id>=0", "outputFields": ["id", "value"]}'

assumption_audit.note: No assumption violations - the test setup correctly loads collection after insert and queries stats immediately. The invariant (milvus_invariant_insert_count_001) explicitly states: 'After inserting N entities, get_stats must report rowCount >= N', which is clearly violated.

contract_refs: constraint_id: milvus_behavioral_collections_get_stats_001 - 'Get stats returns row count and statistics'
invariant_id: milvus_invariant_insert_count_001 - 'After inserting N entities, get_stats must report rowCount >= N'

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST /collections/get_stats -> handler_v2.go:680 (getCollectionStats) -> proxy.GetCollectionStatistics -> datacoord services.go:414 (GetCollectionStatistics) -> meta.GetNumRowsOfCollection -> meta.go:482 (SelectSegments with isSegmentHealthy filter) -> rowCount calculation only includes segments with valid states
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: GetCollectionStatistics通过GetNumRowsOfCollection计算rowCount，而GetNumRowsOfCollection仅统计isSegmentHealthy返回true的segments。isSegmentHealthy会过滤掉SegmentState_None/NotExist/Dropped状态的segments。问题: 刚insert后未flush的segments可能处于不被统计的中间状态(如SegmentState_Growing)，导致rowCount=0但数据实际可查询。这是源码层面的invariant violation。

falsification.probe: Independent verification via entities/get and entities/query proves data actually exists despite rowCount=0
falsification.observed: Step 4 falsification SUCCESS: Direct primary key access (entities/get with ids=[0,1,2]) returned all 3 entities: [{"id":0,"value":0},{"id":1,"value":1},{"id":2,"value":2}]. Independent entities/query with filter='id>=0' also returned 3 rows. This proves the invariant violation is real - rowCount underreports actual data count.

mundane_explanation.note: Not a mundane issue - this is a legitimate gap between segment state machine and statistics reporting. Growing segments not yet flushed are queryable but excluded from rowCount statistics.
